_comment: KARTUN model catalogue - the single source for downloadable models (plans/05_model_catalogue.md step 2). Files are served from the GitHub release `models` of MikalaiKryvusha/KARTUN (the owner's variant B, 2026-10-14 22:04); every file carries its SHA-256 and size, the app refuses a download whose hash differs. `published: false` = not uploaded to the release yet. `builtin: true` = shipped inside the APK, `default: true` = the model a first launch starts with (the owner's pick 2026-10-15 14:12: NomosWebPhoto RealPLKSR by default + NMKD Siax), still listed so the cards show it; `purpose` names the card's description string (model_purpose_<purpose>), `kind` the filter chip; gpuMsPerMp/cpuMsPerMp start the time estimate until the device learns its own. Licences: researches/03 section C. The models belong to their authors.
